# Module `lune_ui_winit::access`

[API reference](../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_winit`](index.md)

The AccessKit bridge, behind the `accesskit` feature: the frame's semantic tree goes out as an
AccessKit tree, and the actions an assistive client sends come back as [`AccessAction`](../lune-ui-core/access.md#struct.AccessAction)s.

[`tree_update`](access.md#fn.tree_update) and [`action_from`](access.md#fn.action_from) are pure, so nearly all of the bridge tests with no window.
[`AccessBridge`](access.md#struct.AccessBridge) owns the OS adapter. AccessKit calls its handlers on a thread of its choosing,
so they touch only [`Shared`], never the `Ui`, the window or the [`Translator`](input.md#struct.Translator): the frame reads
`Shared` on the app's thread, in [`AccessBridge::drain`](access.md#method.AccessBridge.drain) and [`AccessBridge::update`](access.md#method.AccessBridge.update). A handler
holds the queue's lock only to push; `wake` runs with no lock held.

Every value here comes from outside this module and is trusted in no way. The tree is a public
struct, so `tree_update` assumes nothing about its shape (AccessKit panics on a malformed
update, and an inconsistent text run can panic it later, when a client reads it). An action
comes from another process, so `action_from` refuses what it cannot map and the queue is capped.

## Structs

<a id="struct.AccessBridge"></a>
### Struct `AccessBridge`

```rust
pub struct AccessBridge {
    // some fields omitted
}
```

One window's bridge to the OS accessibility API. The app calls [`AccessBridge::window_event`](access.md#method.AccessBridge.window_event)
with every window event before it handles it, [`AccessBridge::drain`](access.md#method.AccessBridge.drain) before a frame and
[`AccessBridge::update`](access.md#method.AccessBridge.update) after one. Drop it before the window.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-winit/src/access.rs:630`

  window, and may run on any thread, so it should only post to the event loop.

<a id="struct.NodeCache"></a>
### Struct `NodeCache`

```rust
pub struct NodeCache {
    // some fields omitted
}
```

What the last update sent, so the next sends only what changed. Empty before the first update
and after [`NodeCache::clear`](access.md#method.NodeCache.clear); an update from empty is a full tree.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-winit/src/access.rs:59`

## Functions

<a id="fn.action_from"></a>
### Function `action_from`

```rust
pub fn action_from(req: &accesskit::ActionRequest) -> Option<lune_ui_core::access::AccessAction>
```

The action an assistive client asked for, or `None` for anything with no meaning here: an
action core does not have, another tree, a `SetValue` with no usable value. A node id passes
unchecked, as core ignores a target it cannot find.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-winit/src/access.rs:472`

<a id="fn.tree_update"></a>
### Function `tree_update`

```rust
pub fn tree_update(
    tree: &lune_ui_core::access::SemanticTree,
    focused: Option<lune_ui_core::ui::WidgetId>,
    root: &RootInfo,
    prev: &mut NodeCache,
) -> accesskit::TreeUpdate
```

The update that takes AccessKit from what `prev` holds to this frame's tree. From an empty
`prev` it is a full tree; otherwise it carries the nodes that changed, and a child that went is
told by its parent's `children`. Focus falls back to the window for an id the tree lacks.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-winit/src/access.rs:149`
